title: Computer maker Framework notifies ‘all customers’ of a data breach

body:
Computer maker Framework has informed its entire customer base about a significant data breach that has compromised personal information.

What happened

Framework, a company known for its modular laptops, has officially notified all customers of a data breach that occurred recently. The breach has resulted in unauthorized access to sensitive customer information, including names, email addresses, phone numbers, and physical addresses. The company has taken steps to inform its users about the incident and the potential risks associated with the exposure of their personal data.

Why it matters

This data breach raises serious concerns about customer privacy and the security measures employed by technology companies. With personal information like names and contact details now potentially in the hands of malicious actors, customers may face increased risks of identity theft and phishing attacks. The breach underscores the importance of robust cybersecurity practices and the need for companies to protect customer data diligently. As Framework works to address the fallout from this incident, it highlights the ongoing challenges that tech companies face in safeguarding sensitive information in an increasingly digital world.

Source: techcrunch.com.
